chunks: Abu Jumaylah narrated from Zayd al-Shammam: regarding a man who was fasting and rinsed his mouth (madmadah).
He said: 'He should not swallow his saliva until he spits it out three times.' - 998-66 - And it has been narrated: 'once.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on swallowing saliva while rinsing the mouth during fasting?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the juristic debate regarding the preservation of fast validity by preventing the accidental ingestion of water mixed with saliva during *madmadah*. The discrepancy between the three-time and single-time spitting reflects the broader Shia scholarly discussion on whether the water itself or the saliva constitutes the ingested substance that breaks the fast. It underscores the meticulous attention to detail in Shia fiqh regarding the physical acts of worship.
